channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Clybourn Place Redevelopment Moves Forward Without Proposed Apartment Building
item.description: The owner of the Lincoln Park shopping center plans to begin demolition soon and move ahead with a retail-only redevelopment under the site’s existing zoning.

item.title: New Video Shows Man Killed By Chicago Cops ‘Posed No Threat,’ Lawyers For Family Say
item.description: Chicago police said Roberto Calvario Jr. accelerated his car and dragged an officer last month, prompting the officer to fire his weapon. But lawyers for Calvario's family say body cam footage contradicts that narrative.

item.title: As Bitter Cold Settles In, Chicago Tallies Homeless Population
item.description: City workers, volunteers and homeless services providers fanned out across the city to conduct the annual point-in-time count of people living unhoused, as some sought shelter to escape dangerously low wind chills.

item.title: Chicago Food Banks, Pantries Brace For Changes In SNAP Benefits Starting Feb. 1
item.description: Pantries are anticipating increased demand as new work requirements leave thousands of neighbors at risk of losing food assistance. "We're preparing for an ongoing hunger crisis," a food bank administrator said.

item.title: Commuters, Tourists — And Even A Few Swimmers — Brave Brutal Cold
item.description: With temperatures well below zero Friday morning, schools and some businesses and museums closed for the day and many people stayed inside. Still, a few courageous souls ventured out.

item.title: Fleurish Brings Flowers To Bronzeville, A South Loop Cafe And More Near South Business News
item.description: BRONZEVILLE — A new flower shop blooms on 43rd Street while the South Loop welcomes a new cafe, door supplier and K-Beauty store. item.title: 60 Years After MLK’s Chicago March, ‘Fierce Urgency Of Now’ Exhibit Reflects On His Legacy
item.description: Seven artists use sonic and visual elements to reinterpret Bernard Kleina's iconic 1966 photos of King and depict where the world is 60 years later.

item.title: Chicago Organizers Stand In Solidarity With Minneapolis, Demand ‘ICE Out Of Everywhere’
item.description: Rapid response members and labor leaders decried immigration raids in Minnesota where federal agents are using “the same playbook” as Chicago, violently detaining people and endangering communities.

item.title: Chicagoans, Local Leaders Say ICE ‘Must Be Abolished’ After Killing Of Minneapolis Nurse Alex Pretti
item.description: A series of protests in Chicago followed Pretti's fatal shooting. Gov. JB Pritzker and Mayor Brandon Johnson called for ICE to be abolished.

item.title: Lake Effect Snow Pummels Chicago As Dangerous Cold Expected To Linger
item.description: Lakefront areas could see as much as a foot of snow Sunday while the brutal cold spell will continue through early this week, according to the National Weather Service.
